source.authoring_tool_base_commit_notes: The rackboy-fixture-gen binary is an additive crate landed on top of D-002's pinned extractor commit; the commit recorded here is the base the tool builds on, not the commit that contains the tool itself.
source.supersedes: rackboy-n61 stub fixture documented in D-002; see D-006 for the populated-fixture authorship decision.
source.authoring_procedure_note: Authored via lsdj-sav's Project::write_instrument API, not the extractor CLI. A fresh LSDJ 9.4.0 ROM boot produces only ~13 APU writes (one short boot tone) and cannot supply the Pulse/Wave/Noise instrument mix rackboy needs. The extractor CLI path from docs/USING_EXTRACTOR.md (extract -> plan-export -> commit-export) was tried first and produced only 2 pulse candidates with no wave or noise; the rackboy-fixture-gen binary provides a deterministic, reproducible author path that does not depend on a running LSDJ song.

scope_note: This fixture is a populated bank containing two Pulse instruments (slots 0 and 1), one Wave instrument (slot 2), and one Noise instrument (slot 3). It exercises the SPIKE-4 container layer, LSDJ block-chain RLE decompression (0xC0 RLE + 0xE0 0xFF terminator + 0xE0 0xF0 default-wave expansion opcodes), per-instrument type classification, and the header version-byte happy path (header byte at 0x8100 is 0x1B because the fixture-gen binary runs the real store_project recompressor). It does NOT yet exercise LSDJ table rows, kit instruments, or CH3 wave-frame indirection.

slot_0.name_raw_bytes_hex_notes: Exactly 8 bytes per LSDJ NAME_LEN (crates/lsdj-sav/src/header.rs:15). Covers offsets [0x8000, 0x8008).
slot_0.header_version_byte_notes: Populated fixtures that go through lsdj-sav's store_project path write the authoritative 0x1B format-version byte into both the decompressed song (at 0x7FFF) and the header quick-scan copy (at 0x8100). No load-time warning expected.

block_allocation.owner_byte_layout_notes: Offsets 0x8141..=0x814B (11 bytes) hold 0x00 (slot 0). Offsets 0x814C..=0x81FF (180 bytes) hold 0xFF (unused). The same 11-block allocation as the empty-template stub — fixture-gen overwrites the existing blocks in place via lsdj-sav's store_project; it does not grow the allocation.

decompressed_song.format_version_notes: The decompressed song's version byte at offset 0x7FFF MUST equal 0x1B. This is the authoritative LSDJ format version check per docs/COMPATIBILITY.md. A parser whose decoder produces a non-0x1B value here must Reject the fixture.
decompressed_song.instrument_alloc_map_notes: Bytes in [0x2040, 0x2044) are 0x01 (allocated). Bytes in [0x2044, 0x2080) are 0x00 (unallocated). The allocated-slot byte value is the sentinel that write_instrument sets (see crates/lsdj-sav/src/project.rs::write_instrument).
decompressed_song.wave_frames_present: default wave pattern filled via 0xE0 0xF0 expansion during decompression; the Wave instrument in slot 2 references wave_index 0 by default

instruments.pulse_split_convention_note: LSDJ .sav does not distinguish Pulse1 vs Pulse2 at the instrument-type-byte level — both are type 0x00 (Pulse). The pulse1_count / pulse2_count split encoded here is the rackboy-fixture-gen authoring convention: slot 0 was authored for Pulse1 use (duty 10, envelope 0xF0), slot 1 was authored for Pulse2 use (duty 01, envelope 0xE0). Rackboy parsers that derive channel assignment from song-chain usage rather than the authoring convention will report pulse_count=2 and both pulseN_count fields as 0 or unset; that is an acceptable alternate interpretation.
